countdown: All stations are Go. Watch for 4 big moments: liftoff, max-Q, separation and orbit.

liftoff.name: LIFTOFF
liftoff.pass: The engines push harder than the rocket weighs, so up it goes!
liftoff.fail: The engines can't push hard enough to climb. The launch is called off.

maxq.name: MAX-Q
maxq.pass: The moment the air pushes hardest on the rocket. It holds together!
maxq.fail: The air pushed harder than the rocket could take.

separation.name: SEPARATION
separation.pass: The empty first stage drops away. Lighter, the rocket speeds up.
separation.fail: The empty stage won't let go, so the rocket is too heavy to climb.

orbit.name: ORBIT
orbit.pass: Engine cut-off. Fast enough to keep falling around Earth: that's orbit!
orbit.fail: Not fast enough to keep falling around Earth, so no orbit this time.

skipped: Something is pulling the capsule up...
alien: Wait. Is that a flying saucer?!
It's pulling the whole rocket up. Mission Control has no words.
failure: Launch failure. The crew is safe.
homeEarly: Heading home early. The crew is safe.

lightning.saved: The crew resets the systems. Still flying.
lightning.unfixed: The strike knocked out the controls!

life_support.alert: Life support alarm! It keeps the capsule's air safe to breathe.
life_support.saved: The crew patches it. Air is flowing again.
life_support.unfixed: Life support can't be fixed up here. Time to head home early.

solar.saved: The crew works it loose. Power is back.
solar.unfixed: Without the panel, power runs low. Time to head home early.

power.alert: Power is running low! The battery runs the lights, radio and air.
power.saved: The crew shuts down everything extra. The battery is back up.
power.unfixed: Not enough power to stay up here. Time to head home early.
